content.short: Alt Fun is a Hyperliquid launchpad issuing coins backed by Hyperliquid perps liquidity.
content.description: Alt Fun is a token launchpad on HyperEVM where every launch is paired with a Hyperliquid perpetual market. Because the token's price references that perp, it keeps moving even when nobody is trading the spot pool, and a new listing draws on the chain's existing perpetuals liquidity from the moment it goes live. The launchpad handles deployment and the market linkage together, so a creator never has to seed a pool separately.
content.meta: Launch tokens on Hyperliquid backed by the chain's existing perpetuals liquidity rather than an empty pool.
